args.body:
Dear Customer,
This email confirms that a refund of **120 CHF** for currency conversion loss on your invoice has been successfully processed. The original error involved an incorrect application of EUR to a CHF-based transaction.

**Refund Status**: Processed via our contract system (Record C-9377). Please review your banking statement within 5 business days for the transfer receipt. If you do not see it by then, reply directly to confirm any pending reconciliation. For urgent matters, contact our Support Team at **support@company.com** or our live I.T. chat.*

Thank you for your patience.

- IT Operations Team, AdapterWorks

*P.S. Reference for your records: **CHF-3022-CR17**.
